title: asperula galioides var. pyrenaica
intro: Asperula galioides var. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean Woodruff, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) characterized by its small, white or pinkish flowers and narrow, pointed leaves. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pyrenean Woodruff include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its ability to protect against free radicals and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Asperula galioides var. pyrenaica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
